name: Protect him
source:
You feel like someone is stalking you. Thankfully, you make a new friend who really likes you and tries to help you stay safe. Unfortunately, the stalker seems angry.

[From [url=https://games-of-crimsin.itch.io/protect-him]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你感觉有人在跟踪你。值得庆幸的是，你结识了一位真正喜欢你并尽力帮助你保持安全的新朋友。不幸的是，跟踪者似乎很生气。

[来自[url=https://games-of-crimsin.itch.io/protect-him]itch.io[/url]]
